name: Largest Shattered Set
definition: The **Largest Shattered Set** is the maximum cardinality of a subset of the domain shattered by $\mathcal{H}$; it is the VC dimension of $\mathcal{H}$.
graph_summary: The largest number of coordinates on which every labeling is realized.
origin_references: This is the Vapnik--Chervonenkis shattering parameter; see \cite{vapnik1971uniform}.

monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly VC dimension: every set shattered by a subfamily is also shattered by its containing class.

p_monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly VC dimension: every set shattered by a projection is shattered by the original class on the same coordinates.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

strictly_monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly VC dimension. For $\mathcal H=\{000,001,011,100\}$, conditioning the third coordinate gives two fibres of value 1, while the full class also has value 1; strict c-monotonicity fails.
